Kwame, the only figure in #coastal-team for Saltmarsh is 10%, not 12%. On Nov 17 Bettina first posted 12%, then corrected it the same afternoon: "please ignore my earlier note, it's 10%," after misreading a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. I didn't find a later change.

Since it came from a draft worksheet, I'd confirm 10% with June before it goes into the renewal brief. Anything above 10% needs Anselm's approval.
